decisionQuestion: Did prompt-cache write/read list prices appear beside an unchanged Sonnet 3.5 base input/output?

before.quote: The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window
before.extraction: Official Claude 3.5 Sonnet announcement. Before-rows are those two explicit base list prices. Unit recorded as USD/MTok, the unit Anthropic uses on the later cache post.

after.quote: Claude 3.5 Sonnet ... Input $3 / MTok Prompt caching $3.75 / MTok - Cache write $0.30 / MTok - Cache read Output $15 / MTok ... Writing to the cache costs 25% more than our base input token price ... using cached content is significantly cheaper
after.extraction: Official prompt-caching announcement dated December 17, 2024. Base input/output stay $3 / $15 MTok. After-rows add cache write $3.75 / MTok and cache read $0.30 / MTok from the same table. 25% more than $3 is $3.75; that checks the write row only.

limits: Cache write/read are extra SKUs, not a change to base input.
TTL, minimum cacheable tokens, and actual cache-hit rate are not in these rows.
Released wrapper currently treats added rows as no-budget-delta.
